landing.title: Automate your repository with AI agents
landing.message: Answer a few questions and get a ready-to-run agentic workflow for your repository.
landing.hint: Takes about a minute — no sign-in required.

finish.step_description: copy your prompt and run it
finish.title: Your workflow generator prompt is ready
finish.message: Copy it, then paste it into your agent from the repository you want to automate.
finish.copy_failure_status: Prompt could not be copied. Please try again.

assistant.button: Let the wizard pick for me
assistant.label: Describe what you want to automate
assistant.field_placeholder: e.g., Every morning, summarize the issues opened yesterday and post a digest…
assistant.hint: A small language model runs in your browser (WebGPU when available) and picks the closest scenario. The model is downloaded once and kept in your browser storage.
assistant.no_match_status: No close match found. Pick a scenario below.
assistant.empty_status: Describe what you want to automate first.
assistant.no_scenarios_status: Scenarios are not available yet. Please try again.
assistant.failure_status: The in-browser model could not analyze the request. Pick a scenario below.
assistant.fallback_status: The in-browser model is unavailable. Closest keyword match:

copy_success.title: Your workflow is one prompt away
copy_success.description: Open your coding agent from the repository you want to automate, then paste the prompt to generate your agentic workflow.
copy_success.next_step_description: Your agent will take it from there.
